description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 MAG to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Water Ability Boost, Triplecast Water, Unlimited Water Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Water Abilities, Water Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Water Abilities; Ends after using 8 Water abilities
TP Max: AOE Water/NE magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
Single-target Water/NE piercing magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;

WS Blue: [Dualcast Water, Instant Water & Weakness Damage +30%] for 3 turns to user
WS Gold: [Dualcast Water, Instant Water & Weakness Damage +30%] for 2 turns to all allies
